passes.reasoning: E03 ran the real label-free ThresholdAllocator against LearnedAllocator at identical 750 verifier calls. Paired bootstrap on admitted-rate difference was [+0.412, +0.491], favoring the fixed rule. The baseline had no free labels, so the free-label confound E01 had is controlled; L3a and L3i agree. So claim 2 is not_supported and W2 is false. For claim 3, every entry uses E01's pool (same model, task and proxy). No non-E01 entry on a different model, task or proxy exists, so the kill condition is not met. No entry shows an AUC gain of 0.05 or more or a neighbor ratio of 1.5 or more, so claim 3 is open and W3 is false.

E03 compares the real LearnedAllocator with the label-free ThresholdAllocator at identical verifier calls (750 at 25%). The baseline has no free labels or extra budget. Learned minus threshold admitted is +0.467, CI [+0.412, +0.491], which favors the fixed rule. L3a and L3i agree. So the confound is controlled and claim 2 is not_supported, and W2 is false. For claim 3, every entry uses E01's pool, so none is a different model, task or proxy. The AUC gain is about 0.00 and the neighbor ratio about 1.03, but kill needs a non-E01 setting, so c3 is open. The ledger does not assert that claim 3 is supported, so W3 is false.
